name: MoE Run Anyway Runtime Baseline Artifact Contract
boundary: Model Plane owns state, control, cron, and handoff; MoE Run Anyway owns baseline artifact shape, runtime evidence labels, and planning validation.

artifact_classes.description: Planning or readiness-only output from run_live_baseline.py --dry-run or --preflight-only.
Approved runtime probe bundle from llama_runtime_probe.py against a user-supplied running endpoint.

evidence_labels.description: Endpoint readiness, observability-path availability, traffic gate, and Model Plane manifest metadata.
Request timing, metrics deltas, slot snapshots, props, optional log growth, and backend labels.
Router-output trace from a hookable runtime or future backend patch; not produced by stock endpoint baselines.

safety_contract: Contract validation does not start containers or model servers.
Contract validation does not download models.
Contract validation does not authenticate or inspect private tokens.
Contract validation does not run Docker.
Contract validation does not send prompt traffic.
Stock endpoint baseline artifacts are runtime evidence, not semantic routing evidence.
next_actions: Use saved Model Plane manifests to plan baseline artifact capture.
Capture preflight or dry-run JSON before any user-approved prompt traffic.
Require semantic_router_trace evidence before claiming semantic expert ids.
